purpose: rollout-3val.meta.json records torch_version but not the model revision. The original meta is preserved unchanged to keep the hash chain reviewers verified; this sidecar supplies the revision the experiment register row needs.
note: src/webshop_lab/model.py load() does not accept or pass a revision, so the run meta cannot carry it automatically. Cache refs/main was pointed at the verified commit to allow offline loading. See Issue #3 for the proposed fix.
